{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rates for each channel
clicks = sales_df.groupby('channel').size()
conversions = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = conversions / clicks

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate['email'] - conversion_rate['paid_search']

# Print results
difference"}
